name: Omnipotent Industries Limited
summary: Omnipotent Industries Limited specializes in the international import, export, and distribution of bitumen. The company's diverse product range features bitumen, alongside furnace oil, light diesel oil, medium turpentine oil, various base oils, polymers, and polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Prince Pratap Shah founded this enterprise on September 15, 2016, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Mumbai, India.
